player_prompt.intro:
Droeueuh Player {player_id} meu'main game Pig Dice.

Aturan:
- Bak turn droe, gata lagee '[roll]' atawa '[hold]'
- Roll 2-6: Tamah keu turn total droe
- Roll 1: Leupah turn total droe ngon akhe turn
- Hold: Tamah turn total droe keu skor droe ngon akhe turn
- Phön {winning_score} peunteut jipeutang

Bak turn droe, gata eu skor ngon turn total jinoe.
Jaweuëb ngon '[roll]' keu roll dadu atawa '[hold]' keu bank peunteut droe.
